data.one_liner: Adds Sentry performance tracing and error capture to Dio HTTP requests.
data.what_it_does: The package extends Dio with Sentry integration, automatically creating performance spans and breadcrumbs for each request. It also captures exceptions from failed HTTP status codes or parsing errors.
use_when: You already use Dio for networking and want automatic Sentry tracing and error reporting.
You need performance monitoring of HTTP calls across all supported platforms.
avoid_when: You are not using Dio (e.g., using http or graphql packages).
You do not use Sentry or prefer a different crash‑reporting solution.
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux
Captures both performance spans and breadcrumbs automatically
weaknesses: Only works with Dio, not other HTTP clients
Adds a small runtime overhead to each request
Limited configuration compared to full Sentry SDK
data.setup_notes: Initialize Sentry SDK with a DSN before calling dio.addSentry(). No native permissions required.

alternatives.name: sentry
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core Sentry SDK without Dio‑specific integration, useful if you handle HTTP manually.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full Flutter Sentry integration; you can add manual spans around Dio calls if you prefer not to use the package.
